Note: a lot of lib changes moving build environments (Vue CLI to Vite).  We were also locked to older versions of other packages due to lack of support from Vue CLI.

I dont know if anybody else is encountering this or not
But I am getting logged out and keep being landed on the login page whenever I try to navigate to any other page from the sidebar post login

Can you add the steps to run the changes in local?

I deleted the node modules and package-lock.json in local.
verified the node version as 22.16.0
Ran `npm install`
then `npm run serve`. But failing to login.

Is there any changes needed in .env.development.local or .env.local, Changing BASE_URL, etc...?

If you can include them in the commit, It will be helpful for the reviewers.

I updated the patch, please try again!

The only thing in my .env file testing this is:
```
NODE_ENV=development
BASE_URL="https:<bmc_ip>"
```

I was able to reproduce.
I updated the patch:
* Fixed 401 interceptor to properly detect login attempts (POST to SessionService/Sessions)
* Fixed isLoggedIn getter to handle undefined tokens correctly (!!state.xAuthToken)
* Added missing isAuthenticatedCookie re-read in authSuccess
* (fix) `resetStoreState` no longer wipes the in-memory xAuthToken when shouldPersistAuthToken is false
Done
Able to login now.
